values.binNote: The bin only stores the total bleed damage (NaafiriQ.BleedBaseDamage=[35/60/85/110/135], bonus AD ratio 0.8) delivered over BleedDuration=5 seconds in ticks every BleedInterval=0.5s, i.e. 10 ticks. The wiki's per-tick value divides these totals by 10 (35/10..135/10, 0.8/10=0.08); no bin row states the per-tick number directly.

TotalMaxDamageSecondCast = (BaseDamageSecondCast + SecondCastMaxADRatio=0.7 x bonus ad) * ExecuteMultiplier=2, which yields base 2x[30/42.5/55/67.5/80]=[60/85/110/135/160] and AD coefficient 0.7*2=1.4, matching the wiki numbers; ExecuteMultiplier and SecondCastMaxADRatio are only multiplicative factors within that calculation and carry no standalone number stated by this value.

values.meaning: Recast lockout time (earliest recast is possible)
values.binNote: Wiki description states the recast becomes available after 0.5 seconds, but the bin's NaafiriQ.RecastLockout value is 0.75.

values.meaning: Recast window (time within which recast is free)
values.quote: within 4 seconds at no additional cost

mechanics.claim: The recast can be used again for free within a 4 second window after the first cast, at no additional cost.
mechanics.quote: ''Darkin Daggers'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds and within 4 seconds at no additional cost.

mechanics.claim: If the dagger hits a target that is already bleeding (i.e. a prior application from the first cast or a prior recast), it instead deals the remaining bleed damage all at once plus additional bonus damage, rather than applying a new bleed.
mechanics.quote: If the dagger hits a target that is already {{as|bleeding|buzzword3}}, they are instead {{ccs|dealt|physical}} the remaining {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} damage plus {{as|'''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: The additional bonus damage on a bleeding target scales with the target's missing health, up to a cap at 100% missing health.
mechanics.quote: with the '''base bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}} and the ''scaling'' for the '''bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 250 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: Naafiri only heals herself from this bonus damage if the target is a champion or a large monster (not applicable against a plain target dummy unless it counts as a champion).
mechanics.quote: If that target is also a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, '''Naafiri''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself.

mechanics.claim: The additional damage calculation uses the target's missing health before the remaining bleed damage is applied, meaning the bleed damage does not increase the missing-health scaling of the bonus hit that delivers it.
mechanics.quote: ''Darkin Daggers'' calculates its additional damage based on missing health before applying the remaining bleed damage.

mechanics.claim: The bleed's execute against minions considers both the initial hit and any prior bleed ticks when checking whether the target is under the execute threshold.
mechanics.quote: ''Darkin Daggers' '' {{tip|execute}} against minions considers both the damage of the initial hit of the dagger and any bleed tick for putting the target under the threshold.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins only after its effects/cast (including recast) resolve, not at the moment of the initial cast.
